Function.Comment: Groups for Take-up correction of UC

Function.Name: Totals
Function.Comment: Save total eligibles to UC: for people not eligible to LB

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Take-up correction of UC based on observed take-up: 1st part purely based on observed take-up

Parameter.Name: comp_cond
Parameter.Comment: if take-up observed... (& in 2020/21 Covid-19 shocks: take-up if taking up in the baseline)

Parameter.Name: comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: ...assume the benefit is claimed (otherwise simulated value is set back to 0)

Function.Name: Totals
Function.Comment: Save total observed TU of UC: for people not eligible to LB

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Calculate take-up rate after correction of UC based purely on observed take-up: for people not eligible to LB

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Calculate probability to sample to go back to target if surpassed: for people not eligible to LB

Parameter.Name: Comp_Cond
Parameter.Comment: (0,0,1) new entitled/takers AND; some people with obs UC take-up...

Parameter.Name: Comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: ... we need to sample from those taking up with a Pr to go back to the target, i.e. TU%_obs - TU%_obs * Pr = target -> Pr= 1 - target/TU%_obs (and if TU%_obs<target -> Pr<0 so nobody is sampled). E.g. if TU%_obs=0.8 and target=0.75 -> Pr=1 - 0.75/0.8=1 - 0.94 = 0.06, then if we sample with thar Pr from the takers: TU%_obs*Pr=0.8*0.06=0.05, and remove that from 0.8, we are back to the target 0.75.

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Reducing full take-up variable before correction if target is surpassed by obs takers: for non-takers in base system and people not eligible to LB

Parameter.Name: Comp_Cond
Parameter.Comment: (1,0,1) non-takers in base system AND; taking UC because obs AND; sampled to be reduced... (& in 2020/21 Covid-19 shocks: not take-up if not taking up in the baseline) (for this group as target=0, "Pr= 1" and everybody is "sampled")

Parameter.Name: comp_cond
Parameter.Comment: (0,0,1) new entitled/takers AND; taking UC because obs AND; sampled to be reduced... (& in 2020/21 Covid-19 shocks: not take-up if not taking up in the baseline)

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Calculate probability to sample among eligible people non-observed taking-up to match target rate

Parameter.Name: comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: ... we need to sample from those w/o obs TU & takers bef 1st obs correction with a Pr to achieve the target. That group is (1 - TU%_obs) and the Pr is such that target = TU%_obs + (1 - TU%_obs) * Pr -> Pr = (target - TU%_obs) / (1 - TU%_obs) (and if target < TU%_obs -> Pr < 0 -> output_var = 0 and nobody is sampled as we already achieved the target).

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Take-up correction of UC based on observed take-up: 2nd part randomly assigning remaining take-up

Parameter.Name: comp_cond
Parameter.Comment: Not observed take-up AND; eligible AND; i_rand_tu<probability to sample among eligible non-observed take-upers to match target rate... (& in 2020/21 Covid-19 shocks: take-up if taking up in the baseline)

Parameter.Name: comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: ... reinstate benefit before any take-up correction

(in 2020/21 Covid-19 shocks: take-up if taking up in the baseline, if eligible after shock although not eligible in the baseline or no longer taking up WTC after shock, which could also happen to non-takers in base system, for whom in other years the benefit was already made 0. Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Reducing full take-up variable before correction if target is surpassed by obs takers

Parameter.Name: comp_cond
Parameter.Comment: If take-up (till here if sim and obs) AND; TU%_obs>target AND; there is some obs TU (=denominator > 0 ) AND; sampled among those taking up with a Pr to go back to the target, i.e. TU%_obs - TU%_obs * Pr = target -> Pr= 1 - target/TU%_obs (and if TU%_obs<target -> Pr<0 so nobody is sampled)

Parameter.Name: comp_cond
Parameter.Comment: E.g. if TU%_obs=0.8 and target=0.75 -> Pr=1 - 0.75/0.8=1 - 0.94 = 0.06, then if we sample with thar Pr from the takers: TU%_obs*Pr=0.8*0.06=0.05, and remove that from 0.8, we are back to the target 0.75.

Parameter.Comment: If take-up (till here if sim and obs) AND; we just made 0 the full take-up variable before correction...

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Calculate probability to sample among eligible people non-observed taking-up to match target rate

Parameter.Name: comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: We need to sample from those w/o obs TU & takers bef 1st obs correction with a Pr to achieve the target. That group is (1 - TU%_obs) and the Pr is such that target = TU%_obs + (1 - TU%_obs) * Pr -> Pr = (target - TU%_obs) / (1 - TU%_obs) (and if target < TU%_obs -> Pr < 0 -> output_var = 0 and nobody is sampled as we already achieved the target).

Parameter.Name: comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: E.g. if TU%_obs=0.4 and target=0.73 -> Pr = (target - TU%_obs) / (1 - TU%_obs) = (0.73 - 0.4) / 0.6 = 0.55, then if we sample with thar Pr from the previously takers: TU%_obs*Pr=0.6*0.55=0.33, and add that to 0.4, we achieve the target 0.73.

Function.Name: ArithOp
Function.Comment: Calculate probability to sample among remaining CTC takers to match transition target

Parameter.Name: Formula
Parameter.Comment: We need to sample from those w/o obs UC & taker of ben with a Pr to achieve the target. That group is (1 - TR%_obs) and the Pr is such that $UCtransition = TR%_obs + (1 - TR%_obs) * Pr -> Pr= Pr = (target - TR%_obs) / (1 - TR%_obs) (and if target < TR%_obs -> Pr < 0 -> output_var = 0 and nobody is sampled as we already achieve the target).

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Reducing full take-up variable before correction if target is surpassed by obs takers

Parameter.Name: comp_cond
Parameter.Comment: If take-up (till here if sim and obs) AND; TU%_obs>target AND; there is some obs TU (=denominator > 0 ) AND; sampled among those taking up with a Pr to go back to the target, i.e. TU%_obs - TU%_obs * Pr = target -> Pr= 1 - target/TU%_obs (and if TU%_obs<target -> Pr<0 so nobody is sampled)

Parameter.Name: comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: E.g. if TU%_obs=0.8 and target=0.75 -> Pr=1 - 0.75/0.8=1 - 0.94 = 0.06, then if we sample with thar Pr from the takers: TU%_obs*Pr=0.8*0.06=0.05, and remove that from 0.8, we are back to the target 0.75.

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Reducing current take-up if target is surpassed by obs takers

Parameter.Name: comp_cond
Parameter.Comment: If take-up (till here if sim and obs) AND; we just made 0 the full take-up variable before correction...

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Calculate probability to sample among eligible people non-observed taking-up to match target rate

Parameter.Name: comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: We need to sample from those w/o obs TU & takers bef 1st obs correction with a Pr to achieve the target. That group is (1 - TU%_obs) and the Pr is such that target = TU%_obs + (1 - TU%_obs) * Pr -> Pr = (target - TU%_obs) / (1 - TU%_obs) (and if target < TU%_obs -> Pr < 0 -> output_var = 0 and nobody is sampled as we already achieved the target).

Parameter.Name: comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: E.g. if TU%_obs=0.4 and target=0.73 -> Pr = (target - TU%_obs) / (1 - TU%_obs) = (0.73 - 0.4) / 0.6 = 0.55, then if we sample with thar Pr from the previously takers: TU%_obs*Pr=0.6*0.55=0.33, and add that to 0.4, we achieve the target 0.73.

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Take-up correction of IS based on observed take-up: 2nd part randomly assigning remaining take-up

Parameter.Name: comp_cond
Parameter.Comment: Not observed take-up AND; eligible AND; i_rand_tu<probability to sample among eligible non-observed take-upers to match target rate

Function.Name: ArithOp
Function.Comment: Calculate probability to sample among remaining IS/JSA takers to match transition target

Parameter.Name: Formula
Parameter.Comment: We need to sample from those w/o obs UC & taker of ben with a Pr to achieve the target. That group is (1 - TR%_obs) and the Pr is such that $UCtransition = TR%_obs + (1 - TR%_obs) * Pr -> Pr= Pr = (target - TR%_obs) / (1 - TR%_obs) (and if target < TR%_obs -> Pr < 0 -> output_var = 0 and nobody is sampled as we already achieve the target).

Parameter.Name: Output_Var
Parameter.Comment: E.g. if TR%_obs=0.15 and target=$UCtransition=0.4 -> Pr = (target - TR%_obs) / (1 - TR%_obs) = (0.4 - 0.15) / 0.85 = 0.29, then if we sample with thar Pr from those w/o obs UC & taker of ben: (1 - TR%_obs)*Pr=0.85*0.29=0.25, and add that to 0.15, we achieve the target 0.4.

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Calculate probability to sample from those made 0 to go back to target if surpassed

Parameter.Name: Comp_Cond
Parameter.Comment: If some people with obs UC transitioned...

Parameter.Name: Comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: ... we need to sample from those made 0 with a Pr to go back to the target, i.e. TR%_obs - TR%_obs * Pr = $UCtransition -> Pr= 1 - target/TR%_obs (and if TR%_obs<target -> Pr<0 so nobody is sampled)

Parameter.Name: Comp_Cond
Parameter.Comment: For old datasets without people with obs UC ...

Parameter.Name: Output_Var
Parameter.Comment: E.g. if TR%_obs=0.15 and target=$UCtransition=0.05 -> Pr=1 - 0.05/0.15= 1 - 0.33 = 0.66, then if we sample with thar Pr from those made 0: TR%_obs*Pr=0.15*0.66=0.10, and remove that from 0.15, we are back to the target 0.05.

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Reducing transition if target is surpassed by obs UC takers

Parameter.Name: comp_cond
Parameter.Comment: If taker bef trans AND; no taker after AND; TR%_obs>target AND; sampled. In 2020/21 Covid-19 shocks: ensure new benefit claims are to UC only and not to the legacy benefits (and old claims to LB)

Function.Name: ArithOp
Function.Comment: Calculate probability to sample among remaining Ir-ESA takers to match transition target

Parameter.Name: Formula
Parameter.Comment: We need to sample from those w/o obs UC & taker of ben with a Pr to achieve the target. That group is (1 - TR%_obs) and the Pr is such that $UCtransition = TR%_obs + (1 - TR%_obs) * Pr -> Pr= Pr = (target - TR%_obs) / (1 - TR%_obs) (and if target < TR%_obs -> Pr < 0 -> output_var = 0 and nobody is sampled as we already achieve the target).

Parameter.Name: Output_Var
Parameter.Comment: E.g. if TR%_obs=0.15 and target=$UCtransition=0.4 -> Pr = (target - TR%_obs) / (1 - TR%_obs) = (0.4 - 0.15) / 0.85 = 0.29, then if we sample with thar Pr from those w/o obs UC & taker of ben: (1 - TR%_obs)*Pr=0.85*0.29=0.25, and add that to 0.15, we achieve the target 0.4.

Function.Comment: Reducing full take-up variable before correction if target Ir-ESA surpassed by obs takers

Parameter.Name: comp_cond
Parameter.Comment: If take-up (till here if sim and obs) AND; TU%_obs>target AND; there is some obs TU (=denominator > 0 ) AND; sampled among those taking up with a Pr to go back to the target, i.e. TU%_obs - TU%_obs * Pr = target -> Pr= 1 - target/TU%_obs (and if TU%_obs<target -> Pr<0 so nobody is sampled)

Parameter.Name: comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: E.g. if TU%_obs=0.8 and target=0.75 -> Pr=1 - 0.75/0.8=1 - 0.94 = 0.06, then if we sample with thar Pr from the takers: TU%_obs*Pr=0.8*0.06=0.05, and remove that from 0.8, we are back to the target 0.75.

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Calculate probability to sample among eligible people non-observed taking-up to match target rate

Parameter.Name: comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: We need to sample from those w/o obs TU & takers bef 1st obs correction with a Pr to achieve the target. That group is (1 - TU%_obs) and the Pr is such that target = TU%_obs + (1 - TU%_obs) * Pr -> Pr = (target - TU%_obs) / (1 - TU%_obs) (and if target < TU%_obs -> Pr < 0 -> output_var = 0 and nobody is sampled as we already achieved the target).

Parameter.Name: comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: E.g. if TU%_obs=0.4 and target=0.73 -> Pr = (target - TU%_obs) / (1 - TU%_obs) = (0.73 - 0.4) / 0.6 = 0.55, then if we sample with thar Pr from the previously takers: TU%_obs*Pr=0.6*0.55=0.33, and add that to 0.4, we achieve the target 0.73.

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Reducing full take-up variable before correction if target is surpassed by obs takers

Parameter.Name: comp_cond
Parameter.Comment: For group 1 the target is 100%; therefore, TU%_obs<target and we never need to reduce

Parameter.Name: comp_cond
Parameter.Comment: If take-up (till here if sim and obs) AND; TU%_obs>target AND; sampled among those taking up with a Pr to go back to the target, i.e. TU%_obs - TU%_obs * Pr = target -> Pr= 1 - target/TU%_obs (and if TU%_obs<target -> Pr<0 so nobody is sampled)

Parameter.Name: comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: E.g. if TU%_obs=0.8 and target=0.75 -> Pr=1 - 0.75/0.8=1 - 0.94 = 0.06, then if we sample with thar Pr from the takers: TU%_obs*Pr=0.8*0.06=0.05, and remove that from 0.8, we are back to the target 0.75.

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Reducing current take-up if target is surpassed by obs takers

Parameter.Name: comp_cond
Parameter.Comment: If take-up (till here if sim and obs) AND; we just made 0 the full take-up variable before correction...

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Calculate probability to sample among eligible people non-observed taking-up to match target rate

Parameter.Name: comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: For group 1 the target is 100%; therefore, the Pr is also 100% and we will be just putting back the elig non obs

Parameter.Name: comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: We need to sample from those w/o obs TU & takers bef 1st obs correction with a Pr to achieve the target. That group is (1 - TU%_obs) and the Pr is such that target = TU%_obs + (1 - TU%_obs) * Pr -> Pr = (target - TU%_obs) / (1 - TU%_obs) (and if target < TU%_obs -> Pr < 0 -> output_var = 0 and nobody is sampled as we already achieved the target).

Parameter.Name: comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: E.g. if TU%_obs=0.4 and target=0.73 -> Pr = (target - TU%_obs) / (1 - TU%_obs) = (0.73 - 0.4) / 0.6 = 0.55, then if we sample with thar Pr from the previously takers: TU%_obs*Pr=0.6*0.55=0.33, and add that to 0.4, we achieve the target 0.73.

Parameter.Name: comp_cond
Parameter.Comment: Not observed take-up AND; eligible AND; i_rand_tu<probability to sample among eligible non-observed take-upers to match target rate

Function.Comment: Calculate probability to sample from those made 0 to go back to target if surpassed

Parameter.Name: Comp_Cond
Parameter.Comment: If some people with obs UC transitioned...

Parameter.Name: Comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: ... we need to sample from those made 0 with a Pr to go back to the target, i.e. TR%_obs - TR%_obs * Pr = $UCtransition -> Pr= 1 - target/TR%_obs (and if TR%_obs<target -> Pr<0 so nobody is sampled)

Parameter.Name: Comp_Cond
Parameter.Comment: For old datasets without people with obs UC ...

Parameter.Name: Output_Var
Parameter.Comment: E.g. if TR%_obs=0.15 and target=$UCtransition=0.05 -> Pr=1 - 0.05/0.15= 1 - 0.33 = 0.66, then if we sample with thar Pr from those made 0: TR%_obs*Pr=0.15*0.66=0.10, and remove that from 0.15, we are back to the target 0.05.

Parameter.Name: comp_cond

Function.Name: ArithOp
Function.Comment: Calculate probability to sample among remaining HB takers to match transition target

Parameter.Name: Formula
Parameter.Comment: We need to sample from those w/o obs UC & taker of ben with a Pr to achieve the target. That group is (1 - TR%_obs) and the Pr is such that $UCtransition = TR%_obs + (1 - TR%_obs) * Pr -> Pr= Pr = (target - TR%_obs) / (1 - TR%_obs) (and if target < TR%_obs -> Pr < 0 -> output_var = 0 and nobody is sampled as we already achieved the target).

Parameter.Name: Output_Var
Parameter.Comment: E.g. if TR%_obs=0.15 and target=$UCtransition=0.4 -> Pr = (target - TR%_obs) / (1 - TR%_obs) = (0.4 - 0.15) / 0.85 = 0.29, then if we sample with thar Pr from those w/o obs UC & taker of ben: (1 - TR%_obs)*Pr=0.85*0.29=0.25, and add that to 0.15, we achieve the target 0.4.

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Reducing full take-up variable before correction if target is surpassed by obs takers

Parameter.Name: comp_cond
Parameter.Comment: If take-up (till here if sim and obs) AND; TU%_obs>target AND; sampled among those taking up with a Pr to go back to the target, i.e. TU%_obs - TU%_obs * Pr = target -> Pr= 1 - target/TU%_obs (and if TU%_obs<target -> Pr<0 so nobody is sampled)

Parameter.Name: comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: E.g. if TU%_obs=0.8 and target=0.75 -> Pr=1 - 0.75/0.8=1 - 0.94 = 0.06, then if we sample with thar Pr from the takers: TU%_obs*Pr=0.8*0.06=0.05, and remove that from 0.8, we are back to the target 0.75.

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Reducing current take-up if target is surpassed by obs takers

Parameter.Name: comp_cond
Parameter.Comment: If take-up (till here if sim and obs) AND; we just made 0 the full take-up variable before correction...

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Calculate probability to sample among eligible people non-observed taking-up to match target rate

Parameter.Name: comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: ... the target is 100%; therefore, the Pr is also 100% and we will be just putting back the elig non obs

Parameter.Name: comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: We need to sample from those w/o obs TU & takers bef 1st obs correction with a Pr to achieve the target. That group is (1 - TU%_obs) and the Pr is such that target = TU%_obs + (1 - TU%_obs) * Pr -> Pr = (target - TU%_obs) / (1 - TU%_obs) (and if target < TU%_obs -> Pr < 0 -> output_var = 0 and nobody is sampled as we already achieved the target).

Parameter.Name: comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: E.g. if TU%_obs=0.4 and target=0.73 -> Pr = (target - TU%_obs) / (1 - TU%_obs) = (0.73 - 0.4) / 0.6 = 0.55, then if we sample with thar Pr from the previously takers: TU%_obs*Pr=0.6*0.55=0.33, and add that to 0.4, we achieve the target 0.73.

Parameter.Name: comp_cond
Parameter.Comment: Not observed take-up AND; eligible AND; i_rand_tu<probability to sample among eligible non-observed take-upers to match target rate

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Calculate probability to sample to go back to target if surpassed: for people not eligible to LB

Parameter.Name: Comp_Cond
Parameter.Comment: (0,0,1) new entitled/takers AND; some people with obs UC take-up...

Parameter.Name: Comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: ... we need to sample from those taking up with a Pr to go back to the target, i.e. TU%_obs - TU%_obs * Pr = target -> Pr= 1 - target/TU%_obs (and if TU%_obs<target -> Pr<0 so nobody is sampled). E.g. if TU%_obs=0.8 and target=0.75 -> Pr=1 - 0.75/0.8=1 - 0.94 = 0.06, then if we sample with thar Pr from the takers: TU%_obs*Pr=0.8*0.06=0.05, and remove that from 0.8, we are back to the target 0.75.

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Reducing full take-up variable before correction if target is surpassed by obs takers: for non-takers in base system and people not eligible to LB

Parameter.Name: Comp_Cond
Parameter.Comment: (1,0,1) non-takers in base system AND; taking UC because obs AND; sampled to be reduced... (& in 2020/21 Covid-19 shocks: not take-up if not taking up in the baseline) (for this group as target=0, "Pr= 1" and everybody is "sampled")

Parameter.Name: comp_cond
Parameter.Comment: (0,0,1) new entitled/takers AND; taking UC because obs AND; sampled to be reduced... (& in 2020/21 Covid-19 shocks: not take-up if not taking up in the baseline)

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Calculate probability to sample among eligible people non-observed taking-up to match target rate

Parameter.Name: comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: ... we need to sample from those w/o obs TU & takers bef 1st obs correction with a Pr to achieve the target. That group is (1 - TU%_obs) and the Pr is such that target = TU%_obs + (1 - TU%_obs) * Pr -> Pr = (target - TU%_obs) / (1 - TU%_obs) (and if target < TU%_obs -> Pr < 0 -> output_var = 0 and nobody is sampled as we already achieved the target).

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Take-up correction of UC based on observed take-up: 2nd part randomly assigning remaining take-up

Parameter.Name: comp_cond
Parameter.Comment: Not observed take-up AND; eligible AND; i_rand_tu<probability to sample among eligible non-observed take-upers to match target rate... (& in 2020/21 Covid-19 shocks: take-up if taking up in the baseline)

Parameter.Name: comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: ... reinstate benefit before any take-up correction

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Reducing full take-up variable before correction if target is surpassed by obs takers

Parameter.Name: comp_cond
Parameter.Comment: If take-up (till here if sim and obs) AND; TU%_obs>target AND; there is some obs TU (=denominator > 0 ) AND; sampled among those taking up with a Pr to go back to the target, i.e. TU%_obs - TU%_obs * Pr = target -> Pr= 1 - target/TU%_obs (and if TU%_obs<target -> Pr<0 so nobody is sampled)

Parameter.Name: comp_cond
Parameter.Comment: E.g. if TU%_obs=0.8 and target=0.75 -> Pr=1 - 0.75/0.8=1 - 0.94 = 0.06, then if we sample with thar Pr from the takers: TU%_obs*Pr=0.8*0.06=0.05, and remove that from 0.8, we are back to the target 0.75.

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Reducing current take-up if target is surpassed by obs takers

Parameter.Name: comp_cond
Parameter.Comment: If take-up (till here if sim and obs) AND; we just made 0 the full take-up variable before correction...

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Calculate probability to sample among eligible people non-observed taking-up to match target rate

Parameter.Name: comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: We need to sample from those w/o obs TU & takers bef 1st obs correction with a Pr to achieve the target. That group is (1 - TU%_obs) and the Pr is such that target = TU%_obs + (1 - TU%_obs) * Pr -> Pr = (target - TU%_obs) / (1 - TU%_obs) (and if target < TU%_obs -> Pr < 0 -> output_var = 0 and nobody is sampled as we already achieved the target).

Parameter.Name: comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: E.g. if TU%_obs=0.4 and target=0.73 -> Pr = (target - TU%_obs) / (1 - TU%_obs) = (0.73 - 0.4) / 0.6 = 0.55, then if we sample with thar Pr from the previously takers: TU%_obs*Pr=0.6*0.55=0.33, and add that to 0.4, we achieve the target 0.73.

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Take-up correction of CTC based on observed take-up: 2nd part randomly assigning remaining take-up

Parameter.Name: comp_cond
Parameter.Comment: Not observed take-up AND; eligible AND; i_rand_tu<probability to sample among eligible non-observed take-upers to match target rate

Function.Comment: Calculate probability to sample from those made 0 to go back to target if surpassed

Parameter.Name: Comp_Cond
Parameter.Comment: If some people with obs UC transitioned...

Parameter.Name: Comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: ... we need to sample from those made 0 with a Pr to go back to the target, i.e. TR%_obs - TR%_obs * Pr = $UCtransition -> Pr= 1 - target/TR%_obs (and if TR%_obs<target -> Pr<0 so nobody is sampled)

Parameter.Name: Comp_Cond
Parameter.Comment: For old datasets without people with obs UC ...

Parameter.Name: Output_Var
Parameter.Comment: E.g. if TR%_obs=0.15 and target=$UCtransition=0.05 -> Pr=1 - 0.05/0.15= 1 - 0.33 = 0.66, then if we sample with thar Pr from those made 0: TR%_obs*Pr=0.15*0.66=0.10, and remove that from 0.15, we are back to the target 0.05.

Parameter.Name: comp_cond

Function.Name: ArithOp
Function.Comment: Calculate probability to sample among remaining CTC takers to match transition target

Parameter.Name: Formula
Parameter.Comment: We need to sample from those w/o obs UC & taker of ben with a Pr to achieve the target. That group is (1 - TR%_obs) and the Pr is such that $UCtransition = TR%_obs + (1 - TR%_obs) * Pr -> Pr= Pr = (target - TR%_obs) / (1 - TR%_obs) (and if target < TR%_obs -> Pr < 0 -> output_var = 0 and nobody is sampled as we already achieve the target).

Parameter.Name: Output_Var
Parameter.Comment: E.g. if TR%_obs=0.15 and target=$UCtransition=0.4 -> Pr = (target - TR%_obs) / (1 - TR%_obs) = (0.4 - 0.15) / 0.85 = 0.29, then if we sample with thar Pr from those w/o obs UC & taker of ben: (1 - TR%_obs)*Pr=0.85*0.29=0.25, and add that to 0.15, we achieve the target 0.4.

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Reducing full take-up variable before correction if target is surpassed by obs takers

Parameter.Name: comp_cond
Parameter.Comment: If take-up (till here if sim and obs) AND; TU%_obs>target AND; there is some obs TU (=denominator > 0 ) AND; sampled among those taking up with a Pr to go back to the target, i.e. TU%_obs - TU%_obs * Pr = target -> Pr= 1 - target/TU%_obs (and if TU%_obs<target -> Pr<0 so nobody is sampled)

Parameter.Name: comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: E.g. if TU%_obs=0.8 and target=0.75 -> Pr=1 - 0.75/0.8=1 - 0.94 = 0.06, then if we sample with thar Pr from the takers: TU%_obs*Pr=0.8*0.06=0.05, and remove that from 0.8, we are back to the target 0.75.

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Reducing current take-up if target is surpassed by obs takers

Parameter.Name: comp_cond
Parameter.Comment: If take-up (till here if sim and obs) AND; we just made 0 the full take-up variable before correction...

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Calculate probability to sample among eligible people non-observed taking-up to match target rate

Parameter.Name: comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: We need to sample from those w/o obs TU & takers bef 1st obs correction with a Pr to achieve the target. That group is (1 - TU%_obs) and the Pr is such that target = TU%_obs + (1 - TU%_obs) * Pr -> Pr = (target - TU%_obs) / (1 - TU%_obs) (and if target < TU%_obs -> Pr < 0 -> output_var = 0 and nobody is sampled as we already achieved the target).

Parameter.Name: comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: E.g. if TU%_obs=0.4 and target=0.73 -> Pr = (target - TU%_obs) / (1 - TU%_obs) = (0.73 - 0.4) / 0.6 = 0.55, then if we sample with thar Pr from the previously takers: TU%_obs*Pr=0.6*0.55=0.33, and add that to 0.4, we achieve the target 0.73.

Parameter.Name: comp_cond
Parameter.Comment: Not observed take-up AND; eligible AND; i_rand_tu<probability to sample among eligible non-observed take-upers to match target rate

Parameter.Name: Comp_Cond

Parameter.Name: Output_Var

Function.Name: ArithOp
Function.Comment: Calculate probability to sample among remaining IS/JSA takers to match transition target

Parameter.Name: Formula
Parameter.Comment: We need to sample from those w/o obs UC & taker of ben with a Pr to achieve the target. That group is (1 - TR%_obs) and the Pr is such that $UCtransition = TR%_obs + (1 - TR%_obs) * Pr -> Pr= Pr = (target - TR%_obs) / (1 - TR%_obs) (and if target < TR%_obs -> Pr < 0 -> output_var = 0 and nobody is sampled as we already achieve the target).

Parameter.Name: Output_Var
Parameter.Comment: E.g. if TR%_obs=0.15 and target=$UCtransition=0.4 -> Pr = (target - TR%_obs) / (1 - TR%_obs) = (0.4 - 0.15) / 0.85 = 0.29, then if we sample with thar Pr from those w/o obs UC & taker of ben: (1 - TR%_obs)*Pr=0.85*0.29=0.25, and add that to 0.15, we achieve the target 0.4.

Function.Name: ArithOp
Function.Comment: Calculate probability to sample among remaining PC-SC takers to match transition target

Parameter.Name: Formula
Parameter.Comment: We need to sample from those w/o obs UC & taker of ben with a Pr to achieve the target. That group is (1 - TR%_obs) and the Pr is such that $UCtransition = TR%_obs + (1 - TR%_obs) * Pr -> Pr= Pr = (target - TR%_obs) / (1 - TR%_obs) (and if target < TR%_obs -> Pr < 0 -> output_var = 0 and nobody is sampled as we already achieve the target).

Parameter.Name: Output_Var
Parameter.Comment: E.g. if TR%_obs=0.15 and target=$UCtransition=0.4 -> Pr = (target - TR%_obs) / (1 - TR%_obs) = (0.4 - 0.15) / 0.85 = 0.29, then if we sample with thar Pr from those w/o obs UC & taker of ben: (1 - TR%_obs)*Pr=0.85*0.29=0.25, and add that to 0.15, we achieve the target 0.4.

Parameter.Name: comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: E.g. if TU%_obs=0.8 and target=0.75 -> Pr=1 - 0.75/0.8=1 - 0.94 = 0.06, then if we sample with thar Pr from the takers: TU%_obs*Pr=0.8*0.06=0.05, and remove that from 0.8, we are back to the target 0.75.

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Calculate probability to sample among eligible people non-observed taking-up to match target rate

Parameter.Name: comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: We need to sample from those w/o obs TU & takers bef 1st obs correction with a Pr to achieve the target. That group is (1 - TU%_obs) and the Pr is such that target = TU%_obs + (1 - TU%_obs) * Pr -> Pr = (target - TU%_obs) / (1 - TU%_obs) (and if target < TU%_obs -> Pr < 0 -> output_var = 0 and nobody is sampled as we already achieved the target).

Parameter.Name: comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: E.g. if TU%_obs=0.4 and target=0.73 -> Pr = (target - TU%_obs) / (1 - TU%_obs) = (0.73 - 0.4) / 0.6 = 0.55, then if we sample with thar Pr from the previously takers: TU%_obs*Pr=0.6*0.55=0.33, and add that to 0.4, we achieve the target 0.73.

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Reducing full take-up variable before correction if target is surpassed by obs takers

Parameter.Name: comp_cond
Parameter.Comment: For group 1 the target is 100%; therefore, TU%_obs<target and we never need to reduce

Parameter.Name: comp_cond
Parameter.Comment: If take-up (till here if sim and obs) AND; TU%_obs>target AND; sampled among those taking up with a Pr to go back to the target, i.e. TU%_obs - TU%_obs * Pr = target -> Pr= 1 - target/TU%_obs (and if TU%_obs<target -> Pr<0 so nobody is sampled)

Parameter.Name: comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: E.g. if TU%_obs=0.8 and target=0.75 -> Pr=1 - 0.75/0.8=1 - 0.94 = 0.06, then if we sample with thar Pr from the takers: TU%_obs*Pr=0.8*0.06=0.05, and remove that from 0.8, we are back to the target 0.75.

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Reducing current take-up if target is surpassed by obs takers

Parameter.Name: comp_cond
Parameter.Comment: If take-up (till here if sim and obs) AND; we just made 0 the full take-up variable before correction...

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Calculate probability to sample among eligible people non-observed taking-up to match target rate

Parameter.Name: comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: For group 1 the target is 100%; therefore, the Pr is also 100% and we will be just putting back the elig non obs

Parameter.Name: comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: We need to sample from those w/o obs TU & takers bef 1st obs correction with a Pr to achieve the target. That group is (1 - TU%_obs) and the Pr is such that target = TU%_obs + (1 - TU%_obs) * Pr -> Pr = (target - TU%_obs) / (1 - TU%_obs) (and if target < TU%_obs -> Pr < 0 -> output_var = 0 and nobody is sampled as we already achieved the target).

Parameter.Name: comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: E.g. if TU%_obs=0.4 and target=0.73 -> Pr = (target - TU%_obs) / (1 - TU%_obs) = (0.73 - 0.4) / 0.6 = 0.55, then if we sample with thar Pr from the previously takers: TU%_obs*Pr=0.6*0.55=0.33, and add that to 0.4, we achieve the target 0.73.

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Take-up correction of HB based on observed take-up: 2nd part randomly assigning remaining take-up

Parameter.Name: comp_cond
Parameter.Comment: Not observed take-up AND; eligible AND; i_rand_tu<probability to sample among eligible non-observed take-upers to match target rate

Function.Comment: Calculate probability to sample from those made 0 to go back to target if surpassed

Parameter.Name: Comp_Cond
Parameter.Comment: If some people with obs UC transitioned...

Parameter.Name: Comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: ... we need to sample from those made 0 with a Pr to go back to the target, i.e. TR%_obs - TR%_obs * Pr = $UCtransition -> Pr= 1 - target/TR%_obs (and if TR%_obs<target -> Pr<0 so nobody is sampled)

Parameter.Name: Comp_Cond
Parameter.Comment: For old datasets without people with obs UC ...

Parameter.Name: Output_Var
Parameter.Comment: E.g. if TR%_obs=0.15 and target=$UCtransition=0.05 -> Pr=1 - 0.05/0.15= 1 - 0.33 = 0.66, then if we sample with thar Pr from those made 0: TR%_obs*Pr=0.15*0.66=0.10, and remove that from 0.15, we are back to the target 0.05.

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Reducing transition if target is surpassed by obs UC takers

Parameter.Name: comp_cond
Parameter.Comment: If taker bef trans AND; no taker after AND; TR%_obs>target AND; sampled. In 2020/21 Covid-19 shocks: ensure new benefit claims are to UC only and not to the legacy benefits (and old claims to LB)

Function.Name: ArithOp
Function.Comment: Calculate probability to sample among remaining HB takers to match transition target

Parameter.Name: Formula
Parameter.Comment: We need to sample from those w/o obs UC & taker of ben with a Pr to achieve the target. That group is (1 - TR%_obs) and the Pr is such that $UCtransition = TR%_obs + (1 - TR%_obs) * Pr -> Pr= Pr = (target - TR%_obs) / (1 - TR%_obs) (and if target < TR%_obs -> Pr < 0 -> output_var = 0 and nobody is sampled as we already achieved the target).

Parameter.Name: Output_Var
Parameter.Comment: E.g. if TR%_obs=0.15 and target=$UCtransition=0.4 -> Pr = (target - TR%_obs) / (1 - TR%_obs) = (0.4 - 0.15) / 0.85 = 0.29, then if we sample with thar Pr from those w/o obs UC & taker of ben: (1 - TR%_obs)*Pr=0.85*0.29=0.25, and add that to 0.15, we achieve the target 0.4.

Parameter.Name: comp_cond
Parameter.Comment: Not observed UC take-up AND; taker of ben bef 1st obs trans AND; i_rand_uc< Pr to sample. In 2020/21 Covid-19 and 2022- U shocks: ensure new benefit claims are to UC only and not to the legacy benefits.

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Reducing full take-up variable before correction if target is surpassed by obs takers

Parameter.Name: comp_cond
Parameter.Comment: If take-up (till here if sim and obs) AND; TU%_obs>target AND; sampled among those taking up with a Pr to go back to the target, i.e. TU%_obs - TU%_obs * Pr = target -> Pr= 1 - target/TU%_obs (and if TU%_obs<target -> Pr<0 so nobody is sampled)

Parameter.Name: comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: E.g. if TU%_obs=0.8 and target=0.75 -> Pr=1 - 0.75/0.8=1 - 0.94 = 0.06, then if we sample with thar Pr from the takers: TU%_obs*Pr=0.8*0.06=0.05, and remove that from 0.8, we are back to the target 0.75.

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Reducing current take-up if target is surpassed by obs takers

Parameter.Name: comp_cond
Parameter.Comment: If take-up (till here if sim and obs) AND; we just made 0 the full take-up variable before correction...

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Calculate probability to sample among eligible people non-observed taking-up to match target rate

Parameter.Name: comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: ... the target is 100%; therefore, the Pr is also 100% and we will be just putting back the elig non obs

Parameter.Name: comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: We need to sample from those w/o obs TU & takers bef 1st obs correction with a Pr to achieve the target. That group is (1 - TU%_obs) and the Pr is such that target = TU%_obs + (1 - TU%_obs) * Pr -> Pr = (target - TU%_obs) / (1 - TU%_obs) (and if target < TU%_obs -> Pr < 0 -> output_var = 0 and nobody is sampled as we already achieved the target).

Parameter.Name: comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: E.g. if TU%_obs=0.4 and target=0.73 -> Pr = (target - TU%_obs) / (1 - TU%_obs) = (0.73 - 0.4) / 0.6 = 0.55, then if we sample with thar Pr from the previously takers: TU%_obs*Pr=0.6*0.55=0.33, and add that to 0.4, we achieve the target 0.73.

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Calculate probability to sample to go back to target if surpassed: for people not eligible to LB

Parameter.Name: Comp_Cond
Parameter.Comment: (0,0,1) new entitled/takers AND; some people with obs UC take-up...

Parameter.Name: Comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: ... we need to sample from those taking up with a Pr to go back to the target, i.e. TU%_obs - TU%_obs * Pr = target -> Pr= 1 - target/TU%_obs (and if TU%_obs<target -> Pr<0 so nobody is sampled). E.g. if TU%_obs=0.8 and target=0.75 -> Pr=1 - 0.75/0.8=1 - 0.94 = 0.06, then if we sample with thar Pr from the takers: TU%_obs*Pr=0.8*0.06=0.05, and remove that from 0.8, we are back to the target 0.75.

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Calculate probability to sample among eligible people non-observed taking-up to match target rate

Parameter.Name: comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: ... we need to sample from those w/o obs TU & takers bef 1st obs correction with a Pr to achieve the target. That group is (1 - TU%_obs) and the Pr is such that target = TU%_obs + (1 - TU%_obs) * Pr -> Pr = (target - TU%_obs) / (1 - TU%_obs) (and if target < TU%_obs -> Pr < 0 -> output_var = 0 and nobody is sampled as we already achieved the target).

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Reducing full take-up variable before correction if target is surpassed by obs takers

Parameter.Name: comp_cond
Parameter.Comment: If take-up (till here if sim and obs) AND; TU%_obs>target AND; there is some obs TU (=denominator > 0 ) AND; sampled among those taking up with a Pr to go back to the target, i.e. TU%_obs - TU%_obs * Pr = target -> Pr= 1 - target/TU%_obs (and if TU%_obs<target -> Pr<0 so nobody is sampled)

Parameter.Name: comp_cond
Parameter.Comment: E.g. if TU%_obs=0.8 and target=0.75 -> Pr=1 - 0.75/0.8=1 - 0.94 = 0.06, then if we sample with thar Pr from the takers: TU%_obs*Pr=0.8*0.06=0.05, and remove that from 0.8, we are back to the target 0.75.

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Reducing current take-up if target is surpassed by obs takers

Parameter.Name: comp_cond
Parameter.Comment: If take-up (till here if sim and obs) AND; we just made 0 the full take-up variable before correction...

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Calculate probability to sample among eligible people non-observed taking-up to match target rate

Parameter.Name: comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: We need to sample from those w/o obs TU & takers bef 1st obs correction with a Pr to achieve the target. That group is (1 - TU%_obs) and the Pr is such that target = TU%_obs + (1 - TU%_obs) * Pr -> Pr = (target - TU%_obs) / (1 - TU%_obs) (and if target < TU%_obs -> Pr < 0 -> output_var = 0 and nobody is sampled as we already achieved the target).

Parameter.Name: comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: E.g. if TU%_obs=0.4 and target=0.73 -> Pr = (target - TU%_obs) / (1 - TU%_obs) = (0.73 - 0.4) / 0.6 = 0.55, then if we sample with thar Pr from the previously takers: TU%_obs*Pr=0.6*0.55=0.33, and add that to 0.4, we achieve the target 0.73.

Parameter.Name: comp_cond
Parameter.Comment: Not observed take-up AND; eligible AND; i_rand_tu<probability to sample among eligible non-observed take-upers to match target rate

Parameter.Comment: If take-up (till here if sim and obs) AND; TU%_obs>target AND; sampled among those taking up with a Pr to go back to the target, i.e. TU%_obs - TU%_obs * Pr = target -> Pr= 1 - target/TU%_obs (and if TU%_obs<target -> Pr<0 so nobody is sampled)

Parameter.Name: comp_cond
Parameter.Comment: E.g. if TU%_obs=0.8 and target=0.75 -> Pr=1 - 0.75/0.8=1 - 0.94 = 0.06, then if we sample with thar Pr from the takers: TU%_obs*Pr=0.8*0.06=0.05, and remove that from 0.8, we are back to the target 0.75.

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Reducing current take-up if target is surpassed by obs takers

Parameter.Name: comp_cond
Parameter.Comment: If take-up (till here if sim and obs) AND; we just made 0 the full take-up variable before correction...

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Calculate probability to sample among eligible people non-observed taking-up to match target rate

Parameter.Name: comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: We need to sample from those w/o obs TU & takers bef 1st obs correction with a Pr to achieve the target. That group is (1 - TU%_obs) and the Pr is such that target = TU%_obs + (1 - TU%_obs) * Pr -> Pr = (target - TU%_obs) / (1 - TU%_obs) (and if target < TU%_obs -> Pr < 0 -> output_var = 0 and nobody is sampled as we already achieved the target).

Parameter.Name: comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: E.g. if TU%_obs=0.4 and target=0.73 -> Pr = (target - TU%_obs) / (1 - TU%_obs) = (0.73 - 0.4) / 0.6 = 0.55, then if we sample with thar Pr from the previously takers: TU%_obs*Pr=0.6*0.55=0.33, and add that to 0.4, we achieve the target 0.73.

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Take-up correction of WTC based on observed take-up: 2nd part randomly assigning remaining take-up

Parameter.Name: comp_cond
Parameter.Comment: Not observed take-up AND; eligible AND; i_rand_tu<probability to sample among eligible non-observed take-upers to match target rate

Function.Name: ArithOp
Function.Comment: Calculate probability to sample among remaining CTC takers to match transition target

Parameter.Name: Formula
Parameter.Comment: We need to sample from those w/o obs UC & taker of ben with a Pr to achieve the target. That group is (1 - TR%_obs) and the Pr is such that $UCtransition = TR%_obs + (1 - TR%_obs) * Pr -> Pr= Pr = (target - TR%_obs) / (1 - TR%_obs) (and if target < TR%_obs -> Pr < 0 -> output_var = 0 and nobody is sampled as we already achieve the target).

Parameter.Name: Output_Var
Parameter.Comment: E.g. if TR%_obs=0.15 and target=$UCtransition=0.4 -> Pr = (target - TR%_obs) / (1 - TR%_obs) = (0.4 - 0.15) / 0.85 = 0.29, then if we sample with thar Pr from those w/o obs UC & taker of ben: (1 - TR%_obs)*Pr=0.85*0.29=0.25, and add that to 0.15, we achieve the target 0.4.

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Reducing full take-up variable before correction if target is surpassed by obs takers

Parameter.Name: comp_cond
Parameter.Comment: If take-up (till here if sim and obs) AND; TU%_obs>target AND; there is some obs TU (=denominator > 0 ) AND; sampled among those taking up with a Pr to go back to the target, i.e. TU%_obs - TU%_obs * Pr = target -> Pr= 1 - target/TU%_obs (and if TU%_obs<target -> Pr<0 so nobody is sampled)

Parameter.Name: comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: E.g. if TU%_obs=0.8 and target=0.75 -> Pr=1 - 0.75/0.8=1 - 0.94 = 0.06, then if we sample with thar Pr from the takers: TU%_obs*Pr=0.8*0.06=0.05, and remove that from 0.8, we are back to the target 0.75.

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Reducing current take-up if target is surpassed by obs takers

Parameter.Name: comp_cond
Parameter.Comment: If take-up (till here if sim and obs) AND; we just made 0 the full take-up variable before correction...

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Calculate probability to sample among eligible people non-observed taking-up to match target rate

Parameter.Name: comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: We need to sample from those w/o obs TU & takers bef 1st obs correction with a Pr to achieve the target. That group is (1 - TU%_obs) and the Pr is such that target = TU%_obs + (1 - TU%_obs) * Pr -> Pr = (target - TU%_obs) / (1 - TU%_obs) (and if target < TU%_obs -> Pr < 0 -> output_var = 0 and nobody is sampled as we already achieved the target).

Parameter.Name: comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: E.g. if TU%_obs=0.4 and target=0.73 -> Pr = (target - TU%_obs) / (1 - TU%_obs) = (0.73 - 0.4) / 0.6 = 0.55, then if we sample with thar Pr from the previously takers: TU%_obs*Pr=0.6*0.55=0.33, and add that to 0.4, we achieve the target 0.73.

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Take-up correction of IS based on observed take-up: 2nd part randomly assigning remaining take-up

Parameter.Name: comp_cond
Parameter.Comment: Not observed take-up AND; eligible AND; i_rand_tu<probability to sample among eligible non-observed take-upers to match target rate

Parameter.Name: Formula
Parameter.Comment: We need to sample from those w/o obs UC & taker of ben with a Pr to achieve the target. Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Calculate probability to sample from those made 0 to go back to target if surpassed

Parameter.Name: Comp_Cond
Parameter.Comment: If some people with obs UC transitioned...

Parameter.Name: Comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: ... we need to sample from those made 0 with a Pr to go back to the target, i.e. TR%_obs - TR%_obs * Pr = $UCtransition -> Pr= 1 - target/TR%_obs (and if TR%_obs<target -> Pr<0 so nobody is sampled)

Parameter.Name: Comp_Cond
Parameter.Comment: For old datasets without people with obs UC ...

Parameter.Name: Output_Var
Parameter.Comment: E.g. if TR%_obs=0.15 and target=$UCtransition=0.05 -> Pr=1 - 0.05/0.15= 1 - 0.33 = 0.66, then if we sample with thar Pr from those made 0: TR%_obs*Pr=0.15*0.66=0.10, and remove that from 0.15, we are back to the target 0.05.

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Reducing transition if target is surpassed by obs UC takers

Parameter.Name: comp_cond
Parameter.Comment: If taker bef trans AND; no taker after AND; TR%_obs>target AND; sampled. In 2020/21 Covid-19 shocks: ensure new benefit claims are to UC only and not to the legacy benefits (and old claims to LB)

Function.Name: ArithOp
Function.Comment: Calculate probability to sample among remaining Ir-ESA takers to match transition target

Parameter.Name: Formula
Parameter.Comment: We need to sample from those w/o obs UC & taker of ben with a Pr to achieve the target. That group is (1 - TR%_obs) and the Pr is such that $UCtransition = TR%_obs + (1 - TR%_obs) * Pr -> Pr= Pr = (target - TR%_obs) / (1 - TR%_obs) (and if target < TR%_obs -> Pr < 0 -> output_var = 0 and nobody is sampled as we already achieve the target).

Parameter.Name: Output_Var
Parameter.Comment: E.g. if TR%_obs=0.15 and target=$UCtransition=0.4 -> Pr = (target - TR%_obs) / (1 - TR%_obs) = (0.4 - 0.15) / 0.85 = 0.29, then if we sample with thar Pr from those w/o obs UC & taker of ben: (1 - TR%_obs)*Pr=0.85*0.29=0.25, and add that to 0.15, we achieve the target 0.4.

Parameter.Name: comp_cond

Parameter.Name: comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: E.g. if TU%_obs=0.8 and target=0.75 -> Pr=1 - 0.75/0.8=1 - 0.94 = 0.06, then if we sample with thar Pr from the takers: TU%_obs*Pr=0.8*0.06=0.05, and remove that from 0.8, we are back to the target 0.75.

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Calculate probability to sample among eligible people non-observed taking-up to match target rate

Parameter.Name: comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: We need to sample from those w/o obs TU & takers bef 1st obs correction with a Pr to achieve the target. That group is (1 - TU%_obs) and the Pr is such that target = TU%_obs + (1 - TU%_obs) * Pr -> Pr = (target - TU%_obs) / (1 - TU%_obs) (and if target < TU%_obs -> Pr < 0 -> output_var = 0 and nobody is sampled as we already achieved the target).

Parameter.Name: comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: E.g. if TU%_obs=0.4 and target=0.73 -> Pr = (target - TU%_obs) / (1 - TU%_obs) = (0.73 - 0.4) / 0.6 = 0.55, then if we sample with thar Pr from the previously takers: TU%_obs*Pr=0.6*0.55=0.33, and add that to 0.4, we achieve the target 0.73.

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Reducing full take-up variable before correction if target is surpassed by obs takers

Parameter.Name: comp_cond
Parameter.Comment: For group 1 the target is 100%; therefore, TU%_obs<target and we never need to reduce

Parameter.Name: comp_cond
Parameter.Comment: If take-up (till here if sim and obs) AND; TU%_obs>target AND; sampled among those taking up with a Pr to go back to the target, i.e. TU%_obs - TU%_obs * Pr = target -> Pr= 1 - target/TU%_obs (and if TU%_obs<target -> Pr<0 so nobody is sampled)

Parameter.Name: comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: E.g. if TU%_obs=0.8 and target=0.75 -> Pr=1 - 0.75/0.8=1 - 0.94 = 0.06, then if we sample with thar Pr from the takers: TU%_obs*Pr=0.8*0.06=0.05, and remove that from 0.8, we are back to the target 0.75.

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Reducing current take-up if target is surpassed by obs takers

Parameter.Name: comp_cond
Parameter.Comment: If take-up (till here if sim and obs) AND; we just made 0 the full take-up variable before correction...

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Calculate probability to sample among eligible people non-observed taking-up to match target rate

Parameter.Name: comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: For group 1 the target is 100%; therefore, the Pr is also 100% and we will be just putting back the elig non obs

Parameter.Name: comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: We need to sample from those w/o obs TU & takers bef 1st obs correction with a Pr to achieve the target. That group is (1 - TU%_obs) and the Pr is such that target = TU%_obs + (1 - TU%_obs) * Pr -> Pr = (target - TU%_obs) / (1 - TU%_obs) (and if target < TU%_obs -> Pr < 0 -> output_var = 0 and nobody is sampled as we already achieved the target).

Parameter.Name: comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: E.g. if TU%_obs=0.4 and target=0.73 -> Pr = (target - TU%_obs) / (1 - TU%_obs) = (0.73 - 0.4) / 0.6 = 0.55, then if we sample with thar Pr from the previously takers: TU%_obs*Pr=0.6*0.55=0.33, and add that to 0.4, we achieve the target 0.73.

Parameter.Name: comp_cond
Parameter.Comment: Not observed take-up AND; eligible AND; i_rand_tu<probability to sample among eligible non-observed take-upers to match target rate

Function.Comment: Calculate transition rate after transition of HB to UC based purely on observed UC

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Calculate probability to sample from those made 0 to go back to target if surpassed

Parameter.Name: Comp_Cond
Parameter.Comment: If some people with obs UC transitioned...

Parameter.Name: Comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: ... we need to sample from those made 0 with a Pr to go back to the target, i.e. TR%_obs - TR%_obs * Pr = $UCtransition -> Pr= 1 - target/TR%_obs (and if TR%_obs<target -> Pr<0 so nobody is sampled)

Parameter.Name: Comp_Cond
Parameter.Comment: For old datasets without people with obs UC ...

Parameter.Name: Output_Var
Parameter.Comment: E.g. if TR%_obs=0.15 and target=$UCtransition=0.05 -> Pr=1 - 0.05/0.15= 1 - 0.33 = 0.66, then if we sample with thar Pr from those made 0: TR%_obs*Pr=0.15*0.66=0.10, and remove that from 0.15, we are back to the target 0.05.

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Reducing transition if target is surpassed by obs UC takers

Parameter.Name: comp_cond
Parameter.Comment: If taker bef trans AND; no taker after AND; TR%_obs>target AND; sampled. In 2020/21 Covid-19 shocks: ensure new benefit claims are to UC only and not to the legacy benefits (and old claims to LB)

Function.Name: ArithOp
Function.Comment: Calculate probability to sample among remaining HB takers to match transition target

Parameter.Name: Formula
Parameter.Comment: We need to sample from those w/o obs UC & taker of ben with a Pr to achieve the target. That group is (1 - TR%_obs) and the Pr is such that $UCtransition = TR%_obs + (1 - TR%_obs) * Pr -> Pr= Pr = (target - TR%_obs) / (1 - TR%_obs) (and if target < TR%_obs -> Pr < 0 -> output_var = 0 and nobody is sampled as we already achieved the target).

Parameter.Name: Output_Var
Parameter.Comment: E.g. if TR%_obs=0.15 and target=$UCtransition=0.4 -> Pr = (target - TR%_obs) / (1 - TR%_obs) = (0.4 - 0.15) / 0.85 = 0.29, then if we sample with thar Pr from those w/o obs UC & taker of ben: (1 - TR%_obs)*Pr=0.85*0.29=0.25, and add that to 0.15, we achieve the target 0.4.

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Reducing full take-up variable before correction if target is surpassed by obs takers

Parameter.Name: comp_cond
Parameter.Comment: If take-up (till here if sim and obs) AND; TU%_obs>target AND; sampled among those taking up with a Pr to go back to the target, i.e. TU%_obs - TU%_obs * Pr = target -> Pr= 1 - target/TU%_obs (and if TU%_obs<target -> Pr<0 so nobody is sampled)

Parameter.Name: comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: E.g. if TU%_obs=0.8 and target=0.75 -> Pr=1 - 0.75/0.8=1 - 0.94 = 0.06, then if we sample with thar Pr from the takers: TU%_obs*Pr=0.8*0.06=0.05, and remove that from 0.8, we are back to the target 0.75.

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Reducing current take-up if target is surpassed by obs takers

Parameter.Name: comp_cond
Parameter.Comment: If take-up (till here if sim and obs) AND; we just made 0 the full take-up variable before correction...

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Calculate probability to sample among eligible people non-observed taking-up to match target rate

Parameter.Name: comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: ... the target is 100%; therefore, the Pr is also 100% and we will be just putting back the elig non obs

Parameter.Name: comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: We need to sample from those w/o obs TU & takers bef 1st obs correction with a Pr to achieve the target. That group is (1 - TU%_obs) and the Pr is such that target = TU%_obs + (1 - TU%_obs) * Pr -> Pr = (target - TU%_obs) / (1 - TU%_obs) (and if target < TU%_obs -> Pr < 0 -> output_var = 0 and nobody is sampled as we already achieved the target).

Parameter.Name: comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: E.g. if TU%_obs=0.4 and target=0.73 -> Pr = (target - TU%_obs) / (1 - TU%_obs) = (0.73 - 0.4) / 0.6 = 0.55, then if we sample with thar Pr from the previously takers: TU%_obs*Pr=0.6*0.55=0.33, and add that to 0.4, we achieve the target 0.73.

Parameter.Name: comp_cond
Parameter.Comment: Not observed take-up AND; eligible AND; i_rand_tu<probability to sample among eligible non-observed take-upers to match target rate

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Calculate probability to sample to go back to target if surpassed: for people not eligible to LB

Parameter.Name: Comp_Cond
Parameter.Comment: (0,0,1) new entitled/takers AND; some people with obs UC take-up...

Parameter.Name: Comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: ... we need to sample from those taking up with a Pr to go back to the target, i.e. TU%_obs - TU%_obs * Pr = target -> Pr= 1 - target/TU%_obs (and if TU%_obs<target -> Pr<0 so nobody is sampled). E.g. if TU%_obs=0.8 and target=0.75 -> Pr=1 - 0.75/0.8=1 - 0.94 = 0.06, then if we sample with thar Pr from the takers: TU%_obs*Pr=0.8*0.06=0.05, and remove that from 0.8, we are back to the target 0.75.

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Reducing full take-up variable before correction if target is surpassed by obs takers: for non-takers in base system and people not eligible to LB

Parameter.Name: Comp_Cond
Parameter.Comment: (1,0,1) non-takers in base system AND; taking UC because obs AND; sampled to be reduced... (& in 2020/21 Covid-19 shocks: not take-up if not taking up in the baseline) (for this group as target=0, "Pr= 1" and everybody is "sampled")

Parameter.Name: comp_cond
Parameter.Comment: (0,0,1) new entitled/takers AND; taking UC because obs AND; sampled to be reduced... (& in 2020/21 Covid-19 shocks: not take-up if not taking up in the baseline)

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Calculate probability to sample among eligible people non-observed taking-up to match target rate

Parameter.Name: comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: ... we need to sample from those w/o obs TU & takers bef 1st obs correction with a Pr to achieve the target. That group is (1 - TU%_obs) and the Pr is such that target = TU%_obs + (1 - TU%_obs) * Pr -> Pr = (target - TU%_obs) / (1 - TU%_obs) (and if target < TU%_obs -> Pr < 0 -> output_var = 0 and nobody is sampled as we already achieved the target).

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Take-up correction of UC based on observed take-up: 2nd part randomly assigning remaining take-up

Parameter.Name: comp_cond
Parameter.Comment: Not observed take-up AND; eligible AND; i_rand_tu<probability to sample among eligible non-observed take-upers to match target rate... (& in 2020/21 Covid-19 shocks: take-up if taking up in the baseline)

Parameter.Name: comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: ... reinstate benefit before any take-up correction

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Reducing full take-up variable before correction if target is surpassed by obs takers

Parameter.Name: comp_cond
Parameter.Comment: If take-up (till here if sim and obs) AND; TU%_obs>target AND; there is some obs TU (=denominator > 0 ) AND; sampled among those taking up with a Pr to go back to the target, i.e. TU%_obs - TU%_obs * Pr = target -> Pr= 1 - target/TU%_obs (and if TU%_obs<target -> Pr<0 so nobody is sampled)

Parameter.Name: comp_cond
Parameter.Comment: E.g. if TU%_obs=0.8 and target=0.75 -> Pr=1 - 0.75/0.8=1 - 0.94 = 0.06, then if we sample with thar Pr from the takers: TU%_obs*Pr=0.8*0.06=0.05, and remove that from 0.8, we are back to the target 0.75.

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Reducing current take-up if target is surpassed by obs takers

Parameter.Name: comp_cond
Parameter.Comment: If take-up (till here if sim and obs) AND; we just made 0 the full take-up variable before correction...

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Calculate probability to sample among eligible people non-observed taking-up to match target rate

Parameter.Name: comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: We need to sample from those w/o obs TU & takers bef 1st obs correction with a Pr to achieve the target. That group is (1 - TU%_obs) and the Pr is such that target = TU%_obs + (1 - TU%_obs) * Pr -> Pr = (target - TU%_obs) / (1 - TU%_obs) (and if target < TU%_obs -> Pr < 0 -> output_var = 0 and nobody is sampled as we already achieved the target).

Parameter.Name: comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: E.g. if TU%_obs=0.4 and target=0.73 -> Pr = (target - TU%_obs) / (1 - TU%_obs) = (0.73 - 0.4) / 0.6 = 0.55, then if we sample with thar Pr from the previously takers: TU%_obs*Pr=0.6*0.55=0.33, and add that to 0.4, we achieve the target 0.73.

Function.Comment: Take-up correction of CTC based on observed take-up: 2nd part randomly assigning remaining take-up

Parameter.Name: comp_cond
Parameter.Comment: Not observed take-up AND; eligible AND; i_rand_tu<probability to sample among eligible non-observed take-upers to match target rate

Function.Comment: Calculate probability to sample from those made 0 to go back to target if surpassed

Parameter.Name: Comp_Cond
Parameter.Comment: If some people with obs UC transitioned...

Parameter.Name: Comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: ... we need to sample from those made 0 with a Pr to go back to the target, i.e. TR%_obs - TR%_obs * Pr = $UCtransition -> Pr= 1 - target/TR%_obs (and if TR%_obs<target -> Pr<0 so nobody is sampled)

Parameter.Name: Comp_Cond
Parameter.Comment: For old datasets without people with obs UC ...

Parameter.Name: Output_Var
Parameter.Comment: E.g. if TR%_obs=0.15 and target=$UCtransition=0.05 -> Pr=1 - 0.05/0.15= 1 - 0.33 = 0.66, then if we sample with thar Pr from those made 0: TR%_obs*Pr=0.15*0.66=0.10, and remove that from 0.15, we are back to the target 0.05.

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Reducing transition if target is surpassed by obs UC takers

Parameter.Name: comp_cond

Function.Name: ArithOp
Function.Comment: Calculate probability to sample among remaining CTC takers to match transition target

Parameter.Name: Formula
Parameter.Comment: We need to sample from those w/o obs UC & taker of ben with a Pr to achieve the target. That group is (1 - TR%_obs) and the Pr is such that $UCtransition = TR%_obs + (1 - TR%_obs) * Pr -> Pr= Pr = (target - TR%_obs) / (1 - TR%_obs) (and if target < TR%_obs -> Pr < 0 -> output_var = 0 and nobody is sampled as we already achieve the target).

Parameter.Name: Output_Var
Parameter.Comment: E.g. if TR%_obs=0.15 and target=$UCtransition=0.4 -> Pr = (target - TR%_obs) / (1 - TR%_obs) = (0.4 - 0.15) / 0.85 = 0.29, then if we sample with thar Pr from those w/o obs UC & taker of ben: (1 - TR%_obs)*Pr=0.85*0.29=0.25, and add that to 0.15, we achieve the target 0.4.

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Reducing full take-up variable before correction if target is surpassed by obs takers

Parameter.Name: comp_cond
Parameter.Comment: If take-up (till here if sim and obs) AND; TU%_obs>target AND; there is some obs TU (=denominator > 0 ) AND; sampled among those taking up with a Pr to go back to the target, i.e. TU%_obs - TU%_obs * Pr = target -> Pr= 1 - target/TU%_obs (and if TU%_obs<target -> Pr<0 so nobody is sampled)

Parameter.Name: comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: E.g. if TU%_obs=0.8 and target=0.75 -> Pr=1 - 0.75/0.8=1 - 0.94 = 0.06, then if we sample with thar Pr from the takers: TU%_obs*Pr=0.8*0.06=0.05, and remove that from 0.8, we are back to the target 0.75.

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Reducing current take-up if target is surpassed by obs takers

Parameter.Name: comp_cond
Parameter.Comment: If take-up (till here if sim and obs) AND; we just made 0 the full take-up variable before correction...

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Calculate probability to sample among eligible people non-observed taking-up to match target rate

Parameter.Name: comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: We need to sample from those w/o obs TU & takers bef 1st obs correction with a Pr to achieve the target. That group is (1 - TU%_obs) and the Pr is such that target = TU%_obs + (1 - TU%_obs) * Pr -> Pr = (target - TU%_obs) / (1 - TU%_obs) (and if target < TU%_obs -> Pr < 0 -> output_var = 0 and nobody is sampled as we already achieved the target).

Parameter.Name: comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: E.g. if TU%_obs=0.4 and target=0.73 -> Pr = (target - TU%_obs) / (1 - TU%_obs) = (0.73 - 0.4) / 0.6 = 0.55, then if we sample with thar Pr from the previously takers: TU%_obs*Pr=0.6*0.55=0.33, and add that to 0.4, we achieve the target 0.73.

Function.Comment: Take-up correction of IS based on observed take-up: 2nd part randomly assigning remaining take-up

Parameter.Name: comp_cond
Parameter.Comment: Not observed take-up AND; eligible AND; i_rand_tu<probability to sample among eligible non-observed take-upers to match target rate

Function.Name: ArithOp
Function.Comment: Calculate probability to sample among remaining IS/JSA takers to match transition target

Parameter.Name: Formula
Parameter.Comment: We need to sample from those w/o obs UC & taker of ben with a Pr to achieve the target. That group is (1 - TR%_obs) and the Pr is such that $UCtransition = TR%_obs + (1 - TR%_obs) * Pr -> Pr= Pr = (target - TR%_obs) / (1 - TR%_obs) (and if target < TR%_obs -> Pr < 0 -> output_var = 0 and nobody is sampled as we already achieve the target).

Parameter.Name: Output_Var
Parameter.Comment: E.g. if TR%_obs=0.15 and target=$UCtransition=0.4 -> Pr = (target - TR%_obs) / (1 - TR%_obs) = (0.4 - 0.15) / 0.85 = 0.29, then if we sample with thar Pr from those w/o obs UC & taker of ben: (1 - TR%_obs)*Pr=0.85*0.29=0.25, and add that to 0.15, we achieve the target 0.4.

Parameter.Comment: E.g. if TR%_obs=0.15 and target=$UCtransition=0.4 -> Pr = (target - TR%_obs) / (1 - TR%_obs) = (0.4 - 0.15) / 0.85 = 0.29, then if we sample with thar Pr from those w/o obs UC & taker of ben: (1 - TR%_obs)*Pr=0.85*0.29=0.25, and add that to 0.15, we achieve the target 0.4.

Parameter.Name: Comp_Cond

Parameter.Comment: E.g. if TR%_obs=0.15 and target=$UCtransition=0.05 -> Pr=1 - 0.05/0.15= 1 - 0.33 = 0.66, then if we sample with thar Pr from those made 0: TR%_obs*Pr=0.15*0.66=0.10, and remove that from 0.15, we are back to the target 0.05.

Function.Name: ArithOp
Function.Comment: Calculate probability to sample among remaining Ir-ESA takers to match transition target

Parameter.Name: Formula
Parameter.Comment: We need to sample from those w/o obs UC & taker of ben with a Pr to achieve the target. That group is (1 - TR%_obs) and the Pr is such that $UCtransition = TR%_obs + (1 - TR%_obs) * Pr -> Pr= Pr = (target - TR%_obs) / (1 - TR%_obs) (and if target < TR%_obs -> Pr < 0 -> output_var = 0 and nobody is sampled as we already achieve the target).

Parameter.Name: Output_Var
Parameter.Comment: E.g. if TR%_obs=0.15 and target=$UCtransition=0.4 -> Pr = (target - TR%_obs) / (1 - TR%_obs) = (0.4 - 0.15) / 0.85 = 0.29, then if we sample with thar Pr from those w/o obs UC & taker of ben: (1 - TR%_obs)*Pr=0.85*0.29=0.25, and add that to 0.15, we achieve the target 0.4.

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Calculate probability to sample among eligible people non-observed taking-up to match target rate

Parameter.Name: comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: We need to sample from those w/o obs TU & takers bef 1st obs correction with a Pr to achieve the target. That group is (1 - TU%_obs) and the Pr is such that target = TU%_obs + (1 - TU%_obs) * Pr -> Pr = (target - TU%_obs) / (1 - TU%_obs) (and if target < TU%_obs -> Pr < 0 -> output_var = 0 and nobody is sampled as we already achieved the target).

Parameter.Name: comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: E.g. if TU%_obs=0.4 and target=0.73 -> Pr = (target - TU%_obs) / (1 - TU%_obs) = (0.73 - 0.4) / 0.6 = 0.55, then if we sample with thar Pr from the previously takers: TU%_obs*Pr=0.6*0.55=0.33, and add that to 0.4, we achieve the target 0.73.

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Reducing full take-up variable before correction if target is surpassed by obs takers

Parameter.Name: comp_cond
Parameter.Comment: For group 1 the target is 100%; therefore, TU%_obs<target and we never need to reduce

Parameter.Name: comp_cond
Parameter.Comment: If take-up (till here if sim and obs) AND; TU%_obs>target AND; sampled among those taking up with a Pr to go back to the target, i.e. TU%_obs - TU%_obs * Pr = target -> Pr= 1 - target/TU%_obs (and if TU%_obs<target -> Pr<0 so nobody is sampled)

Parameter.Name: comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: E.g. if TU%_obs=0.8 and target=0.75 -> Pr=1 - 0.75/0.8=1 - 0.94 = 0.06, then if we sample with thar Pr from the takers: TU%_obs*Pr=0.8*0.06=0.05, and remove that from 0.8, we are back to the target 0.75.

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Reducing current take-up if target is surpassed by obs takers

Parameter.Name: comp_cond
Parameter.Comment: If take-up (till here if sim and obs) AND; we just made 0 the full take-up variable before correction...

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Calculate probability to sample among eligible people non-observed taking-up to match target rate

Parameter.Name: comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: For group 1 the target is 100%; therefore, the Pr is also 100% and we will be just putting back the elig non obs

Parameter.Name: comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: We need to sample from those w/o obs TU & takers bef 1st obs correction with a Pr to achieve the target. That group is (1 - TU%_obs) and the Pr is such that target = TU%_obs + (1 - TU%_obs) * Pr -> Pr = (target - TU%_obs) / (1 - TU%_obs) (and if target < TU%_obs -> Pr < 0 -> output_var = 0 and nobody is sampled as we already achieved the target).

Parameter.Name: comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: E.g. if TU%_obs=0.4 and target=0.73 -> Pr = (target - TU%_obs) / (1 - TU%_obs) = (0.73 - 0.4) / 0.6 = 0.55, then if we sample with thar Pr from the previously takers: TU%_obs*Pr=0.6*0.55=0.33, and add that to 0.4, we achieve the target 0.73.

Parameter.Name: comp_cond
Parameter.Comment: Not observed take-up AND; eligible AND; i_rand_tu<probability to sample among eligible non-observed take-upers to match target rate

Function.Comment: Calculate probability to sample from those made 0 to go back to target if surpassed

Parameter.Name: Comp_Cond

Parameter.Name: Comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: ... we need to sample from those made 0 with a Pr to go back to the target, i.e. TR%_obs - TR%_obs * Pr = $UCtransition -> Pr= 1 - target/TR%_obs (and if TR%_obs<target -> Pr<0 so nobody is sampled)

Parameter.Name: Comp_Cond
Parameter.Comment: For old datasets without people with obs UC ...

Parameter.Name: Output_Var
Parameter.Comment: E.g. if TR%_obs=0.15 and target=$UCtransition=0.05 -> Pr=1 - 0.05/0.15= 1 - 0.33 = 0.66, then if we sample with thar Pr from those made 0: TR%_obs*Pr=0.15*0.66=0.10, and remove that from 0.15, we are back to the target 0.05.

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Reducing transition if target is surpassed by obs UC takers

Parameter.Name: comp_cond
Parameter.Comment: If taker bef trans AND; no taker after AND; TR%_obs>target AND; sampled. In 2020/21 Covid-19 shocks: ensure new benefit claims are to UC only and not to the legacy benefits (and old claims to LB)

Function.Name: ArithOp
Function.Comment: Calculate probability to sample among remaining HB takers to match transition target

Parameter.Name: Formula
Parameter.Comment: We need to sample from those w/o obs UC & taker of ben with a Pr to achieve the target. That group is (1 - TR%_obs) and the Pr is such that $UCtransition = TR%_obs + (1 - TR%_obs) * Pr -> Pr= Pr = (target - TR%_obs) / (1 - TR%_obs) (and if target < TR%_obs -> Pr < 0 -> output_var = 0 and nobody is sampled as we already achieved the target).

Parameter.Name: Output_Var
Parameter.Comment: E.g. if TR%_obs=0.15 and target=$UCtransition=0.4 -> Pr = (target - TR%_obs) / (1 - TR%_obs) = (0.4 - 0.15) / 0.85 = 0.29, then if we sample with thar Pr from those w/o obs UC & taker of ben: (1 - TR%_obs)*Pr=0.85*0.29=0.25, and add that to 0.15, we achieve the target 0.4.

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Reducing full take-up variable before correction if target is surpassed by obs takers

Parameter.Name: comp_cond
Parameter.Comment: If take-up (till here if sim and obs) AND; TU%_obs>target AND; sampled among those taking up with a Pr to go back to the target, i.e. TU%_obs - TU%_obs * Pr = target -> Pr= 1 - target/TU%_obs (and if TU%_obs<target -> Pr<0 so nobody is sampled)

Parameter.Name: comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: E.g. if TU%_obs=0.8 and target=0.75 -> Pr=1 - 0.75/0.8=1 - 0.94 = 0.06, then if we sample with thar Pr from the takers: TU%_obs*Pr=0.8*0.06=0.05, and remove that from 0.8, we are back to the target 0.75.

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Reducing current take-up if target is surpassed by obs takers

Parameter.Name: comp_cond
Parameter.Comment: If take-up (till here if sim and obs) AND; we just made 0 the full take-up variable before correction...

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Calculate probability to sample among eligible people non-observed taking-up to match target rate

Parameter.Name: comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: ... the target is 100%; therefore, the Pr is also 100% and we will be just putting back the elig non obs

Parameter.Name: comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: We need to sample from those w/o obs TU & takers bef 1st obs correction with a Pr to achieve the target. That group is (1 - TU%_obs) and the Pr is such that target = TU%_obs + (1 - TU%_obs) * Pr -> Pr = (target - TU%_obs) / (1 - TU%_obs) (and if target < TU%_obs -> Pr < 0 -> output_var = 0 and nobody is sampled as we already achieved the target).

Parameter.Name: comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: E.g. if TU%_obs=0.4 and target=0.73 -> Pr = (target - TU%_obs) / (1 - TU%_obs) = (0.73 - 0.4) / 0.6 = 0.55, then if we sample with thar Pr from the previously takers: TU%_obs*Pr=0.6*0.55=0.33, and add that to 0.4, we achieve the target 0.73.

Parameter.Name: comp_cond
Parameter.Comment: Not observed take-up AND; eligible AND; i_rand_tu<probability to sample among eligible non-observed take-upers to match target rate

Function.Name: BenCalc

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Calculate probability to sample to go back to target if surpassed: for people not eligible to LB

Parameter.Name: Comp_Cond
Parameter.Comment: (0,0,1) new entitled/takers AND; some people with obs UC take-up...

Parameter.Name: Comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: ... we need to sample from those taking up with a Pr to go back to the target, i.e. TU%_obs - TU%_obs * Pr = target -> Pr= 1 - target/TU%_obs (and if TU%_obs<target -> Pr<0 so nobody is sampled). E.g. if TU%_obs=0.8 and target=0.75 -> Pr=1 - 0.75/0.8=1 - 0.94 = 0.06, then if we sample with thar Pr from the takers: TU%_obs*Pr=0.8*0.06=0.05, and remove that from 0.8, we are back to the target 0.75.

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Reducing full take-up variable before correction if target is surpassed by obs takers: for non-takers in base system and people not eligible to LB

Parameter.Name: Comp_Cond
Parameter.Comment: (1,0,1) non-takers in base system AND; taking UC because obs AND; sampled to be reduced... (& in 2020/21 Covid-19 shocks: not take-up if not taking up in the baseline) (for this group as target=0, "Pr= 1" and everybody is "sampled")

Parameter.Name: comp_cond
Parameter.Comment: (0,0,1) new entitled/takers AND; taking UC because obs AND; sampled to be reduced... (& in 2020/21 Covid-19 shocks: not take-up if not taking up in the baseline)

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Calculate probability to sample among eligible people non-observed taking-up to match target rate

Parameter.Name: comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: ... we need to sample from those w/o obs TU & takers bef 1st obs correction with a Pr to achieve the target. That group is (1 - TU%_obs) and the Pr is such that target = TU%_obs + (1 - TU%_obs) * Pr -> Pr = (target - TU%_obs) / (1 - TU%_obs) (and if target < TU%_obs -> Pr < 0 -> output_var = 0 and nobody is sampled as we already achieved the target).

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Take-up correction of UC based on observed take-up: 2nd part randomly assigning remaining take-up

Parameter.Name: comp_cond
Parameter.Comment: Not observed take-up AND; eligible AND; i_rand_tu<probability to sample among eligible non-observed take-upers to match target rate... (& in 2020/21 Covid-19 shocks: take-up if taking up in the baseline)

Parameter.Name: comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: ... reinstate benefit before any take-up correction

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Reducing full take-up variable before correction if target is surpassed by obs takers

Parameter.Name: comp_cond
Parameter.Comment: If take-up (till here if sim and obs) AND; TU%_obs>target AND; there is some obs TU (=denominator > 0 ) AND; sampled among those taking up with a Pr to go back to the target, i.e. TU%_obs - TU%_obs * Pr = target -> Pr= 1 - target/TU%_obs (and if TU%_obs<target -> Pr<0 so nobody is sampled)

Parameter.Name: comp_cond
Parameter.Comment: E.g. if TU%_obs=0.8 and target=0.75 -> Pr=1 - 0.75/0.8=1 - 0.94 = 0.06, then if we sample with thar Pr from the takers: TU%_obs*Pr=0.8*0.06=0.05, and remove that from 0.8, we are back to the target 0.75.

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Reducing current take-up if target is surpassed by obs takers

Parameter.Name: comp_cond
Parameter.Comment: If take-up (till here if sim and obs) AND; we just made 0 the full take-up variable before correction...

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Calculate probability to sample among eligible people non-observed taking-up to match target rate

Parameter.Name: comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: We need to sample from those w/o obs TU & takers bef 1st obs correction with a Pr to achieve the target. That group is (1 - TU%_obs) and the Pr is such that target = TU%_obs + (1 - TU%_obs) * Pr -> Pr = (target - TU%_obs) / (1 - TU%_obs) (and if target < TU%_obs -> Pr < 0 -> output_var = 0 and nobody is sampled as we already achieved the target).

Parameter.Name: comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: E.g. if TU%_obs=0.4 and target=0.73 -> Pr = (target - TU%_obs) / (1 - TU%_obs) = (0.73 - 0.4) / 0.6 = 0.55, then if we sample with thar Pr from the previously takers: TU%_obs*Pr=0.6*0.55=0.33, and add that to 0.4, we achieve the target 0.73.

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Take-up correction of CTC based on observed take-up: 2nd part randomly assigning remaining take-up

Parameter.Name: comp_cond
Parameter.Comment: Not observed take-up AND; eligible AND; i_rand_tu<probability to sample among eligible non-observed take-upers to match target rate

Function.Name: ArithOp
Function.Comment: Calculate transition rate after transition of CTC to UC based purely on observed UC

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Calculate probability to sample from those made 0 to go back to target if surpassed

Parameter.Name: Comp_Cond
Parameter.Comment: If some people with obs UC transitioned...

Parameter.Name: Comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: ... we need to sample from those made 0 with a Pr to go back to the target, i.e. TR%_obs - TR%_obs * Pr = $UCtransition -> Pr= 1 - target/TR%_obs (and if TR%_obs<target -> Pr<0 so nobody is sampled)

Parameter.Name: Comp_Cond
Parameter.Comment: For old datasets without people with obs UC ...

Parameter.Name: Output_Var
Parameter.Comment: E.g. if TR%_obs=0.15 and target=$UCtransition=0.05 -> Pr=1 - 0.05/0.15= 1 - 0.33 = 0.66, then if we sample with thar Pr from those made 0: TR%_obs*Pr=0.15*0.66=0.10, and remove that from 0.15, we are back to the target 0.05.

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Reducing transition if target is surpassed by obs UC takers

Parameter.Name: comp_cond
Parameter.Comment: If taker bef trans AND; no taker after AND; TR%_obs>target AND; sampled. In 2020/21 Covid-19 shocks: ensure new benefit claims are to UC only and not to the legacy benefits (and old claims to LB)

Function.Name: ArithOp
Function.Comment: Calculate probability to sample among remaining CTC takers to match transition target

Parameter.Name: Formula
Parameter.Comment: We need to sample from those w/o obs UC & taker of ben with a Pr to achieve the target. That group is (1 - TR%_obs) and the Pr is such that $UCtransition = TR%_obs + (1 - TR%_obs) * Pr -> Pr= Pr = (target - TR%_obs) / (1 - TR%_obs) (and if target < TR%_obs -> Pr < 0 -> output_var = 0 and nobody is sampled as we already achieve the target).

Parameter.Name: Output_Var
Parameter.Comment: E.g. if TR%_obs=0.15 and target=$UCtransition=0.4 -> Pr = (target - TR%_obs) / (1 - TR%_obs) = (0.4 - 0.15) / 0.85 = 0.29, then if we sample with thar Pr from those w/o obs UC & taker of ben: (1 - TR%_obs)*Pr=0.85*0.29=0.25, and add that to 0.15, we achieve the target 0.4.

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: UC transition from CTC with obs TU: second part randomly transitioning those without obs UC

Parameter.Name: comp_cond
Parameter.Comment: Not observed UC take-up AND; taker of ben bef 1st obs trans AND; i_rand_uc< Pr to sample. In 2020/21 Covid-19 and 2022- U shocks: ensure new benefit claims are to UC only and not to the legacy benefits.

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Reducing full take-up variable before correction if target is surpassed by obs takers

Parameter.Name: comp_cond
Parameter.Comment: If take-up (till here if sim and obs) AND; TU%_obs>target AND; there is some obs TU (=denominator > 0 ) AND; sampled among those taking up with a Pr to go back to the target, i.e. TU%_obs - TU%_obs * Pr = target -> Pr= 1 - target/TU%_obs (and if TU%_obs<target -> Pr<0 so nobody is sampled)

Parameter.Name: comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: E.g. if TU%_obs=0.8 and target=0.75 -> Pr=1 - 0.75/0.8=1 - 0.94 = 0.06, then if we sample with thar Pr from the takers: TU%_obs*Pr=0.8*0.06=0.05, and remove that from 0.8, we are back to the target 0.75.

Function.Name: BenCalc

Parameter.Name: comp_cond

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Calculate probability to sample among eligible people non-observed taking-up to match target rate

Parameter.Name: comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: We need to sample from those w/o obs TU & takers bef 1st obs correction with a Pr to achieve the target. That group is (1 - TU%_obs) and the Pr is such that target = TU%_obs + (1 - TU%_obs) * Pr -> Pr = (target - TU%_obs) / (1 - TU%_obs) (and if target < TU%_obs -> Pr < 0 -> output_var = 0 and nobody is sampled as we already achieved the target).

Parameter.Name: comp_perTU
Parameter.Comment: E.g. if TU%_obs=0.4 and target=0.73 -> Pr = (target - TU%_obs) / (1 - TU%_obs) = (0.73 - 0.4) / 0.6 = 0.55, then if we sample with thar Pr from the previously takers: TU%_obs*Pr=0.6*0.55=0.33, and add that to 0.4, we achieve the target 0.73.

Function.Name: BenCalc
Function.Comment: Take-up correction of IS based on observed take-up: 2nd part randomly assigning remaining take-up

Parameter.Name: comp_cond
Parameter.Comment: Not observed take-up AND; eligible AND; i_rand_tu<probability to sample among eligible non-observed take-upers to match target rate
